order_note: No predecessor and no order on this engine. SQL 115 needs public.sync_provider_stakeholder_account(uuid) (restored from supabase migration 20260728110453, owned by checksops_admin), the tables payment_provider_accounts, payment_provider_methods, stakeholder_accounts, tenants and tenant_users with the columns the function uses. The function runs after every INSERT or UPDATE of payment_provider_accounts and payment_provider_methods (trg_sync_provider_stakeholder_acct, trg_sync_provider_stakeholder_bank) and keeps one provider_connected partner payout stakeholder per tenant for the tenant's latest receiving account. It assumed one payment account per tenant; a tenant with a Moov account in two environments (staging, 2026-10-25) got a second active partner payout insert, refused by stakeholder_accounts_one_partner_payout (23505), which rolled back moov-sync. SQL 115 replaces only that function (same signature and attributes): no insert when another active partner payout exists, and its own environment's row is re-activated only when no other active payout exists. EXECUTE is revoked from PUBLIC, anon, authenticated and service_role; the callers (trg_sync_provider_stakeholder_account() and add_partner_stakeholder_to_check(uuid, uuid)) are SECURITY DEFINER. Production tenants hold one payment account each, so their behaviour is unchanged; the apply keeps the function identical across environments. If the read-only inspect reports already_applied true nothing is applied.

The pre-conditions refuse a function not owned by the login and any live EXECUTE line other than the owner's and the four the file revokes (function_acl_replaceable), and require the definer to write stakeholder_accounts; the trigger function, the triggers, the unique index and the rest of the catalog are in the unrelated snapshot and must be unchanged. The tooling does not authorize anything: this pin stays execute false until a reviewed change records the staging acceptance, the production inspect and an owner approval.
